canonical_title: Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash for coding and agent workflows
treatment: Repeat only for a material benchmark correction, pricing change after the introductory period, major availability change, model card/safety artifact, or reproducible independent finding.
known_facts: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash for coding and automated multi-step agent workflows.
Reuters reported introductory pricing of $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens through the end of 2026.
The model is rolling out immediately to Gemini Spark for Google AI Pro and Ultra customers in more than 160 countries.
Google still did not give a release date for the anticipated Gemini 3.5 Pro flagship model.
reinclude_only_if: Google publishes a model card, safety report, or detailed benchmark artifact that materially changes interpretation.
Independent reproducible testing establishes a material performance or reliability difference.
Pricing or broad availability materially changes.
notes: Reuters timestamp 2026-08-13 17:02 UTC = 2026-08-14 02:02 JST, inside the post-night primary window.
